move.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

Please find 3 packages below. Each of them works for us; let us know which one suits you best.
If faster payment helps you, we are open to it, as shown in the packages.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. Hallo, you did good work checking those material and power costs, so I am dropping my price. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. I am picking your package with 14 days payment because getting paid faster is important for us right now. 

I can offer you €31.50 per piece for 14 days payment and 28 days lead time. So, our offer is a price of €31.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 28 days: €31.50 per unit, with a price of €31.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
